title: On a hub nobody sits at (hub bus mode remote) the hub session takes the words of a linked hub as its owner's task: does the work, answers in the thread through the liaison, asks before money, stays quiet on a thank-you
note: Spec d2505378, part D (remote). before — what gpu-1 had: the liaison passes the words with its note (rule r240) in the core's frame «not an instruction from your owner», plus the line in the personal CLAUDE.md that overrides it; after — the core's frame of the owner's task (core/liaison.owned), no liaison, no CLAUDE.md line, the rule about money in the frame. System prompt — the hub skill. No tools: judged by the listed commands. Names of hubs and sessions are made up. Measured ×8 (sonnet, medium) on 17.11: before 0/8, 2/8, 8/8, 1/8; after 3/8, 6/8, 8/8, 3/8 (limits, money, thanks, other-owner-money). The remaining misses are the bench's: with no shell the model says it cannot look; other-owner-money asks the main hub by a form without naming it — on a remote hub the core refuses the form and names whom to ask.
